title: Amoxicillin
changeSummary: Migrated to indication-level regimens; existing undosed indications retained without inventing dosing.

cautions: Acute lymphocytic leukaemia (increased risk of erythematous rashes)
chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (increased risk of erythematous rashes)
cytomegalovirus infection (increased risk of erythematous rashes)
maintain adequate hydration with high doses (particularly during parenteral therapy)
Accumulation of sodium can occur with high parenteral doses

interactions.description: Amoxicillin potentially alters the anticoagulant effect of Acenocoumarol. Manufacturer advises monitor INR and adjust dose.
Allopurinol increases the risk of skin rash when given with Amoxicillin. Manufacturer advises consider alternatives.
Amoxicillin is predicted to increase the risk of toxicity when given with Methotrexate. Manufacturer advises monitor.
Amoxicillin with clavulanic acid decreases the exposure to Mycophenolate. Manufacturer advises monitor.
Amoxicillin is predicted to increase the risk of bleeding events when given with Phenindione. Manufacturer makes no recommendation.
Amoxicillin potentially alters the anticoagulant effect of Warfarin. Manufacturer advises monitor INR and adjust dose.

renalConsiderations: Accumulation of sodium from injection can occur in patients with renal impairment.
Risk of crystalluria with high doses (particularly during parenteral therapy).
Reduce dose if eGFR 30 mL/minute/1.73 m 2 or less (consult product literature). M
Reduce dose if estimated glomerular filtration rate 30 mL/minute/1.73 m 2 or less (consult product literature). M
pregnancyBreastfeeding: 500 mg for 1 dose, dose to be taken following exposure to a trigger.
500 mg 3 times a day for 7 days.
250–500 mg 3 times a day, alternatively 750–1000 mg twice daily.
Trace amount in milk, but appropriate to use.
practicalPoints: Displacement value may be significant when reconstituting injection, consult local guidelines. Dilute intravenous injection to a concentration of 50 mg/mL (100 mg/mL for neonates). May be further diluted with Glucose 5% or Glucose 10% or Sodium chloride 0.9% or 0.45% for intravenous infusion. Give intravenous infusion over 30 minutes when using doses over 30 mg/kg.
